# AC Repair in Plano, TX

Need AC repair in Plano? Our licensed technicians find the fault, show you the price in writing and fix most systems on the first visit. You approve the cost before anyone picks up a tool.

## What breaks most often in Plano homes

Plano grew quickly through the 1980s and 1990s, and the median home here dates to 1993. Many of those houses still cool with an older system, and older systems tend to fail in the same few ways. A weak capacitor stops the outdoor fan from turning. A clogged drain line trips the safety switch and shuts the whole unit down. A slow refrigerant leak lets the indoor coil freeze over on a humid afternoon. Our technicians carry those common replacement parts on every service truck, so the majority of repairs take a single trip.

An estimated 20.2% of Plano central systems are 15 years or older, which comes to about 23,300 units. That figure is a model estimate built from Census housing data and a federal survey of equipment ages. If your system falls into that group, ask us to price an [AC replacement](https://www.example-air.test/ac-replacement/) beside the repair so you can compare the two honestly.

## What happens during a repair visit

A technician tests the system and explains in plain words which part failed and why. You see the full price before any work begins. Approve it and we start right away, usually with parts already on the truck. Decline it and you owe only the visit fee we quoted over the phone. The same crew handles [heating repair](https://www.example-air.test/heating-repair/) when the first cold front arrives in November.

## How to avoid the next breakdown

Most summer breakdowns begin as small problems that nobody noticed in the spring. A tune up catches a tired capacitor or a dirty coil before the first week of triple digit heat. Our [maintenance plan](https://www.example-air.test/maintenance-plan/) includes two visits a year and moves members to the front of the line in July. You can also see everything we do across the city on our [Plano heating and air page](https://www.example-air.test/plano-hvac/).

Call our office or [schedule a visit](https://www.example-air.test/contact/) online whenever it suits you. Describe what the system is doing, and our dispatcher will offer an arrival window that fits around your schedule.
